name: zrndr_blend_packed_color_565_with_fog_in_place
description: zRndr::BlendPackedColor565WithFogInPlace blends an in-place packed 565 color toward the active fog packed color using an 8-bit blend factor.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zRndr fog blend helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x49b780 loads the input packed color, computes red/green/blue masked deltas from g_zRndr_FogParamsActive packed color channels scaled by blend255 with signed shifts by 8, and writes the summed in-place packed 565 result.
The native fog commit/blend smoke verifies active fog parameter commit behavior and blends black toward full red/green/blue fog at blend factor 128, producing the expected 0x7bef packed 565 midpoint.
